name: Register with Split Tender
note: The tender ribbon is the order total drawn as a bar: each payment is a flex segment that springs in from zero while the hatched remainder shrinks, and cash suggestions are the exact amount plus the next note up from every denomination. Money is integer cents, with basket discounts allocated across lines by largest remainder before tax by class, every basket change is undoable, and --apo-register-h can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Barcode Item Lookup
note: A real EAN-13 encoder draws the label as SVG modules through the L, G and R patterns picked by the leading digit, with the check digit computed and the parity shown live as you type. A simulated scan sweeps a laser across the bars with a --i stagger before the item resolves to price, stock by store and a shelf label; set --apo-scan-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Returns and Exchanges
note: Return credit and exchange goods hang on a balance beam whose tilt is a registered <angle> eased by a linear() spring, with each pan riding the arm through sin() and cos() of that angle inside its own container. Refunds are at price paid with promotions and tax prorated in cents and routed back to the original tenders, and --apo-returns-h can be set to 100dvh in an app.

name: Receiving Against a Purchase Order
note: Each PO line is a case-pack meter on a subgrid row, one segment per case filling unit by unit with over-receipt hatched past the order, and rows are patched in place so fills transition instead of redrawing. Opening a carton flies its units into the matching lines with the Web Animations API before posting summarises shorts, overs and damages; set --apo-receive-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Stocktake with Variances
note: A blind count sheet hides system quantities until submit, then flips them in with a staggered rotateX while diverging bars grow from the zero line and the chart re-sorts by value impact with a FLIP. Tolerance sliders re-flag recounts live and recounts go blind again; set --apo-count-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Shift and Cash Drawer
note: The drawer is drawn top-down, each compartment a button whose bill stack or coin pile grows with its count, beside a step chart of the drawer level with the time spent over the drop limit shaded. Safe drops and paid-outs take real bills out of the counted drawer and the ledger together, so the blind close still reconciles; set --apo-shift-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Loyalty Member Lookup
note: A phone keypad narrows members digit by digit and marks the matched run, while the tier ring is a conic gradient driven by two registered numbers: progress this year and a ghost arc for the points this basket will earn. Applying a reward re-prices the basket and the projection together; set --apo-loyalty-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Receipt Journal and Reprint
note: Receipts are laid out the way a thermal printer does it, in fixed 32, 42 or 48 character columns with wrapped names, right-aligned amounts, double-width totals and a Code 39 barcode, and printing reveals the paper one line per step with a steps() clip-path. Gift copies, reprint counts and the paper left on the roll all come from the same journal entry; set --apo-receipt-h to 100dvh in an app.
